page.content:
Family-controlled company in Billund that designs and sells LEGO sets.

How The LEGO Group connects

  • Topic: LEGO — The LEGO Group designs and manufactures the LEGO system.
  • Character: Ole Kirk Christiansen — Ole Kirk's toy shop became The LEGO Group.
  • Location: Billund — The LEGO Group is headquartered in Billund.
  • Item: Minifigure — The LEGO Group introduced the minifigure in 1978.
  • Character: Kjeld Kirk Kristiansen — Kjeld Kirk Kristiansen led The LEGO Group through the minifigure and license eras.
  • Work: BIONICLE — The LEGO Group launched BIONICLE as a recovery story line.
  • Work: The LEGO Movie — The LEGO Group backed The LEGO Movie as a brick-world feature.

What is The LEGO Group?

The LEGO Group is the Billund manufacturer that owns the brick, licenses themes, and still sits with the Kirk Kristiansen family after Ole Kirk's wooden-toy workshop became a global plastics house.

Key threads lead to LEGO, Ole Kirk Christiansen, Billund, Minifigure, Kjeld Kirk Kristiansen and BIONICLE.
